paymentAndCollectionParagraph:
Payment Methods: We accept payments via credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard), digital wallets, and instant payment services. Completing the payment constitutes user agreement to our terms and conditions.
Fees: All fees are clearly displayed in the app at the time of purchase. We reserve the right to modify prices and fees with prior notice to users.
bookingCancellationParagraph:
User-Initiated Cancellation: Bookings can be canceled and fully refunded if canceled at least 72 hours before the scheduled service. Cancellations made later may not be eligible for a refund.
Service Provider Cancellation: If the service provider cancels the booking or is unable to deliver the service as agreed, the user is entitled to a full refund.
RefundsParagraph:
Refund Policy: Refund requests are processed using the original payment method. Refunds may take time to appear in your account, depending on your bank's policies.
Exceptional Cases: In cases of service failure or user dissatisfaction, refund requests may be considered at our discretion.
